integrity_note: An explicit analytic proof is given; the standalone computation checks finite instances only. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats renewal arrival indicators rather than accumulated counts; the process is nonstationary and no stationary spectral long-range dependence is asserted. The relative novelty of parts of the Stieltjes representation against broader classical complete-monotonicity theory remains a literature risk.
title: Renewal-arrival moments and positive aging correlations in a discrete fractional Poisson process
